claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product as well made and effective, reporting reduced puffiness and good results with daily use.
A common complaint is that the roller breaks or falls apart quickly, sometimes within days or in transit.
Several reviewers mention the product arrives with nice packaging, including a box and pouch, and some note a helpful guide.
Some reviewers report no results in reducing under-eye bags and express disappointment.
A few reviewers note a squeaking noise, which some resolve with oil or a plastic cap.
